ns2:section.sectionText: This semester, this course introduces students to the basics of neural network modeling. It emphasizes the formal characteristics of the main classes of networks and the evaluation of neural networks as models of human perception and cognition. The course requires familiarity with basic mathematics (matrix algebra and calculus are recommended but not required; basic algebra is a must) and computer programming skills. The course meets with PSYC 331 AB2. NOTE: Students must also register for the lecture section PSYC 593 AL1 crn 47522.
